paite: Tu in zaw, Jakobte, ka sikhate aw, ka tel Israelte aw, ngaikhia unla;
heading: TOUPA Pathian Omsun Ahi
english: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

paite: TOUPA nou hon siampa, sul a pan nou hon bawlpa, nou hon panpih ding pa'n hichi in achi: "Ka sikha Jakob aw, ka tel nou Jeshurunte aw, lau kei un.
english: This is what Yahweh who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

paite: "Dangtakmi tung ah tui ka sung ding a, lei keu ah tui luangte ka sung ding; na suante uh tung ah ka kha ka sung ding a, na tate uh tung ah ka vualzawlna ka sung ding hi.
english: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your seed, and my blessing on your offspring:

paite: Huchi in amau, tui luanna kiang a singhiang kaite apou bang in, loupa lak ah apou ding uh.
english: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

paite: "Mi khat in, TOUPA a ka hi, achi ding a; midang Jakob min in akilou ding a; midang in akhut a, TOUPA, chi a gelh in, Israel min abeh min in azang ding chi in," achi hi.
english: One will say, ‘I am Yahweh’s;’ and another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to Yahweh,’ and honor the name of Israel.”

paite: TOUPA, Israelte Kumpipa, amau tanpa sepaihte TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Kei amasapen pa ka hi a, ananungpen pa ka hi; keimah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei hi.
english: This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

paite: Nidanglai a mite ka seh nungsang kei hih bang in kua'n asam dia, huaite kua'n agen dia, kua'n ahia kei sik a akizom zel a hihlang ding? Thil hong tung dingte leh hong om dingte gen hen.
english: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.

paite: Lau kei unla, kihta sam kei un; tuma lam in na kiang uah ka gen khin in ka hon theisak khin hilou hia? Noute ka palaite na hi uhi. Keimah lou Pathian a-om hiam? Ahi, Suangpi himhim a-om kei; khat lel leng a-om lam ka thei kei."
english: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.”

paite: Milim bawltawm bawl mite avek un huihkhua lel ahi ua; athil deihlam uh aphatuam kei ding; azahlakna ding un amau palaite un leng amu thei kei ua, atheithei kei uhi.
heading: Milim Biakna Nuihsan In A-om
english: Everyone who makes an engraved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t see, nor know, that they may be disappointed.

paite: Kua'n ahia Pathian bawl? Ahihkeileh, kua'n ahia bangmah ding a phatuamloupi milim bawltawm sung?
english: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?

paite: Ngai in, apawlpi tengteng azahlak ding ua; nasem mite leng mihingte lak a mi ahi uh. Avek un kikhawm vek uhenla, dingh uhen; alau ding ua, azahlakkhawm ding uh.
english: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed; and the workmen are mere men. Let them all be gathered together. Let them stand up. They will fear. They will be put to shame together.

paite: Siksek in heipi asek zel a, meihol ah atholh a sek ding bang in asek a, aban hattak in asek zel; ahi, agil ahong kial a, atha ahong zoi zel; tui adawn kei a, abah nak hi.
english: The blacksmith takes an axe, works in the coals, fashions it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is faint.

paite: Singlem bawlmi in khau akaigak a, pensil in ahi ding achiamteh a, nawt mamna in ahihdan ding abawl a, bem bawlna in ahi ding abawl a, mihing lim bang in abawl a, inn a om ding in mihing kilawmna bang in abawl zel hi.
english: The carpenter stretches out a line. He marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house.

paite: Sidar singte akiphuk a, sesing leh tosaw ala a, gammang sing lak a khat amah tuam a om ding in ahihkip a; meilah sing asuan a, vuahtui in avak hi.
english: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes the cypress and the oak, and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest. He plants a fir tree, and the rain nourishes it.

paite: Huai nung in mi a ding a mei a khul ding ahita ding; huai a kipan in ala a, akihihlum zel; ahi, akuangsak a, tanghou ahai zel hi; ahi, pathian abawl a, abe zel hi; huai sing pen milim bawltawm ding in abawl a, huai bokkhup in abia hi.
english: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it, and warms himself. Yes, he burns it, and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god, and worships it; he makes it an engraved image, and falls down to it.

paite: Huai sing khenkhat mei ah akhul a; akhen sa nekna ding in azang a; sa a-em a, atai hi; ahi, meilum a-awi a, "Nuam e, ka lumta, mei mel ka muta e," achi hi.
english: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast, and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself, and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”

paite: Aval pathian ding in abawl a, abawltawm milim mah; huai bokkhup a bia a, akiang ah athum a, "Hon hondam in, ka pathian lah na hi ngal a," achi zel hi.
english: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me; for you are my god!”

paite: Athei kei ua, angaihtuah sam kei uh; ama'n lah amit uh amitsisakta ngal a; atheihsiamlouhna ding un alungtang uh leng akhaksakta hi.
english: They don’t know, neither do they consider: for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see; and their hearts, that they can’t understand.

paite: Huchi in kuamah in atheikhe nawn kei ua, "Mei ah khenkhat ka khul a; ahi, a-am ah tanghou bang in ka hai a; sa leng ka em a, ka ne a; aval thilkihhuai ding in ka bawl ding hia? Sing a suak bokkhup in ka be ding hia? Hih ding in amau ah theihna leh theihsiamna a-om tuan kei hi."
english: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”

paite: Vut kia ane zel a; alungtang khem a om in, ahinna akihumbit theihlouhna ding leh, "Ka khut taklam ah zuau a-om kei a hia?" achih theihlouhna ding in, amah akalsuansakta hi.
heading: TOUPA Thilsiamtu Leh Hondampa
english: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”

paite: "Jakobte aw, huai thilte theigige un, Israelte aw, nou leng theigige un ka sikhate lah na hi ngal ua; kei bawl na hi ua; ka sikhate na hi uh; Israelte aw, ka mangngilh in na om kei ding uhi. TOUPA, bangkim siamtu leh hondampa.
english: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel; for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.

paite: "Na tatleknate uh meipi hihmang bang in ka hihmangta a, na khelhnate uh mei hihmang bang in ka hihmang nalai hi; ka kiang ah hong kik nawn un, nou lah ka hon tanta ngal a," chi in.
english: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

paite: "Vante aw, nuamsatak in la sa un, TOUPA'N lah huaite ahihta ngal a; lei nuailamte aw, kikou un, tangte aw, gamnuai leh asung a sing om chiteng aw, la sakhe guih un; TOUPA'N Jakobte atanta a, Israelte ah akipahtawi ding hi."
english: Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for Yahweh has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

paite: TOUPA, noumau hon tanpa, sul a kipan noute hon bawlpa'n hichi in achi: "Kei zaw TOUPA, thil tengteng siampa, keimah kia a van kaipalhpa, liansakpa ka hi; kua ahia ka kiang a om?
english: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb: “I am Yahweh, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;

paite: "Kei lah zuautheite chiamtehnate bangmah lou a bawl a, aisan siamte mihai a bawlpa, mipilte nunglam ngasak a, atheihna uh haihuai a bawlpa.
english: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

paite: "Asikha thu hihkip a, apalaite lemtheih tangtungsakpa, Jerusalem tungthu a, 'Huai ah mi a-om nawn ding uh, chipa leh Judah gam kho tungthu a, Bawl in a-om nawn chiat ding uh, asiatna lailai ka bawl nawn ding,' chipa.
english: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’

paite: Tui thuk mahmah kiang a, 'Kangtat in, na luite leng ka kangtatsak ding,' chipa.
english: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers;’

paite: "Kura tungthu a, 'Amah zaw ka belamchingpa ahi a, Jerusalem tungthu ah, Bawl in a-om nawn ding,' chih leh tempul kiang ah, 'Na suangphum lep in a-om nawn ding, chi khop hial in ka deihlam tengteng a hih ding,' chipa ka hi," chi in.
english: Who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”
